name: Anisotropic Filtering of Volume Data for LPV
aliases: Central Differencing for LPV Light Leaks
definition: A post-processing mitigation technique applied during the LPV lighting stage to reduce light bleeding (leaks) through walls. It uses a central difference scheme on Spherical Harmonic (SH) coefficients to detect if radiance is flowing away from the surface normal, and dampens the sampled radiance if so.
summary: Anisotropic filtering of volume data for LPV is a post-processing technique that reduces light bleeding by dampening radiance when directional derivatives indicate leaks through walls, operating as a heuristic filter on existing grid data.
